newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - June 9.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - June 9.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Monday:
* On Friday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average advanced 130.49 points or 1.79 percent to close at record high of 7435.78.
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index gained 8.47 points or 0.76 percent to 1,117.31.
* Ringgit quoted at 2.5100/20 a dollar at around 0035 GMT, firmer from its Kuala Lumpur ending on Friday at 2.5138/48.
* Focus on second line stocks seen continuing, analysts said.
* Technical support for key index seen at 1,090 and resistance at 1,135, chartists said.
